svg.title: The recurrent network of the page's run (seed 0) reading the first line of the training text a character at a time: the same cell at every step, its state carried to the next
svg.text: the characters, read one at a time
the state after each: the first 32 of its 256 numbers (accent above 0, the other colour below)
its chances for the next character, the three highest

g.title: Reads 'F', from a state of zeros: the most likely next is a space (0.56); what came, 'i', is not among its three best. 83 of the 256 numbers of its state are beyond 0.9 in size.
g.text: accent: the character that came next; _ is a space
